allowed_inputs.title: explicit user-visible title metadata only; existing anonymous default preserved
allowed_inputs.work_summary: assistant role + explicitly final/final_answer channel or phase + user-visible output_text; reject missing visibility/channel and all analysis/reasoning/system/developer content
allowed_inputs.edited_files: allowlisted edit tool names and structured filepath/edit fields only; no shell command, patch body, tool output or arbitrary JSON text search
allowed_inputs.last_activity: explicit timestamp of allowed observed event
allowed_inputs.state: explicit official task run state or explicit lifecycle event only; otherwise show last activity with unknown completion
allowed_inputs.project: project basename; edited files relative to that project, never absolute home paths

optional_work_summary.text: テスト用カレンダーに現在時刻の目印を追加し、移動操作を確認しました。

approval_needed_before_cloud_sync: whether to include sanitized user-visible work summary
whether to include relative edited-file names/counts
whether to import official dot-task snapshots
